title: Evidence Synthesis and Owner Decision Queue

decision_queue.title: Remove Unused httpx2 Dependency
decision_queue.rationale: Zero consumers in codebase; httpx is the real dependency. Eliminates bloat and supply-chain ambiguity.

decision_queue.title: Isolate Redis Port in Microservices Compose
decision_queue.action: Change 6379:6379 to 127.0.0.1:6379:6379 or remove host port publish entirely
decision_queue.rationale: Prevents unauthenticated Redis access on external interfaces.

decision_queue.title: Enforce Non-Mock Webhook Secrets in Production Mode
decision_queue.action: Fail-closed if SLACK_SIGNING_SECRET or LINE_CHANNEL_SECRET is unset in non-development runtime
decision_queue.rationale: Prevents forgery using known static mock secret strings.

decision_queue.title: Harden Nginx Reverse Proxy Headers
decision_queue.action: Add server_tokens off; and security headers (X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options)
decision_queue.rationale: Prevents MIME sniffing, clickjacking, and server version banner disclosure.

decision_queue.title: Wire Passive spec/ Schemas to Runtime Linter
decision_queue.action: Add optional CLI flag to validate workflow.schema.json
decision_queue.rationale: Closes the schema consumer alignment gap for PAP v0.2.0 compatibility.
